audit.evidence: Blitz-orm is an Object Relational Mapper (ORM) for graph databases that uses a JSON query language called Blitz Query Language (BQL). BQL is similar to GraphQL but uses JSON instead of strings. This makes it easier to build dynamic queries. ／ Blitz-orm is similar to other ORM packages such as Prisma. You define a BQL schema and it gets translated to different databases (currently only compatible with TypeDB and SurrealDB). ／ Blitz-orm is currently in alpha version and not ready for production use. Some key queries and mutations do work, but there is still much that needs to be done and performance improvements are needed. One of the biggest performance issues is with nested queries, as they currently require a call to TypeDB for each level of depth.

提供 library_cite_check 对答案中的 [n] 引用做模糊 token 匹配与语义相似度双重校验，library_diagnose 输出分块统计与自检索探针
支持 hash、外部命令、本地 Ollama 三种嵌入后端，默认零下载、零网络请求，存储后端可选 JSON 或 SQLite

identity.one_liner: AI 编程代理会话的桌面浏览与检索工具
identity.review: SeshBuddy 是一款本地桌面应用，读取 Claude Code、Codex 等 CLI 写入磁盘的会话数据并建立索引，提供树状浏览、全文搜索、归档和流量检查功能，内置反向代理可查看代理请求内容。面向使用 AI 编码代理并需要管理本地会话记录的开发者，基于 Tauri 构建，仅支持 macOS 和 Windows。
highlights: 读取并索引 Claude Code/Codex/Gemini 等 7 个 CLI 的本地会话数据
基于 Tantivy 的本地全文搜索，覆盖 prompt、回复、工具调用与代码块
内置 seshbuddy-proxy 反向代理，可检查请求/响应载荷与 token 用量
use_cases: 集中浏览、搜索与归档多个 AI 编码 CLI 的历史会话
检查 AI 代理与厂商端点之间的 API 请求/响应内容
审查代理对代码的改动差异

classification.eco_why: 读取本地会话文件并本地索引，不依赖外部数据库产品。

audit.evidence: SeshBuddy is a native desktop workbench for the sessions you build with AI coding agents. It reads the session data and logs that Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Antigravity, WorkBuddy, DSH and OpenCode already write to disk, indexes them locally, and gives you one place to browse, search, archive and inspect everything — plus a local reverse proxy that shows you exactly what your agent sends over the wire. ／ |**API Reverse Proxy & Traffic Inspector**|`seshbuddy-proxy` sits between your CLI and the vendor endpoint (**Claude Code** and **Codex**) so you can read request/response payloads, latency and token usage. One click to enable, one click to restore the original endpoint.|
